questions.text: विनिमय दर प्रणाली के अंतर्गत, केन्द्रीय बैंक, विदेशी विनिमय (मुद्रा) दर को सीमाबद्ध रूप से नियंत्रित कर सकता है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: Under the _______ Exchange Rate System, the Central Bank can control the foreign exchange rate in a range bound manner. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: The correct option is (C) Managed floating. Under a managed floating exchange rate system, the central bank intervenes in the foreign exchange market to prevent excessive volatility while allowing the market forces of demand and supply to largely determine the exchange rate.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन कीजिए। अभिकथन (A) : प्रत्यक्ष कर व्यक्तियों/कम्पनियों की आय/लाभ पर आरोपित किए जाते हैं। कारण (R) : प्रत्यक्ष करों के भुगतान का बोझ किसी अन्य इकाई पर स्थानांतरित नहीं किया जा सकता है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): Direct taxes are imposed on income/profits of individuals/companies. Reason (R): The burden of payment of direct taxes cannot be shifted to any other entity.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है。

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (A). Direct taxes are indeed levied on income and profits (Assertion). The defining characteristic of a direct tax is that its incidence and impact fall on the same person, meaning the tax burden cannot be shifted to others, which correctly explains the nature of direct taxes (Reason).

questions.text: कीन्स के सिद्धांत के अंतर्गत, 'संदर्भ रेखा' (Reference Line) _______ कोण पर खींची गई मूल-बिंदु से गुज़रने वाली एक सीधी रेखा है।
questions.text_english: Under the Keynesian theory, 'Reference Line' is a straight line passing through the origin drawn at an angle of _______.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: The correct option is (C) 45°. In Keynesian cross analysis, the aggregate supply or reference line is drawn at a 45-degree angle because, at every point on this line, the value of consumption plus savings (or output) equals the value of income, implying a constant ratio of 1:1.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए : कथन 1 : सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (MPC) से तात्पर्य प्रति आय इकाई उपभोग से है। कथन 2 : आय में वृद्धि के फलस्वरूप, उपभोग के स्तर में आनुपातिक वृद्धि सदैव आय के स्तर में वृद्धि से अधिक होती है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC) refers to the consumption per unit of income. Statement 2: As the income increases, the proportionate increase in the level of consumption is always more than the increase in the level of income.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (D). Statement 1 is false because MPC is the ratio of change in consumption to change in income (ΔC/ΔY), not consumption per unit of income (which is APC). Statement 2 is false because MPC is always less than 1, meaning consumption increases less than the increase in income.

questions.text: प्राथमिक घाटे के मापन का मुख्य उद्देश्य वर्तमान _______ पर ध्यान केन्द्रित करना है।
questions.text_english: The main objective of measuring the primary deficit is to highlight present _______.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: The correct option is (A). Primary deficit is defined as the fiscal deficit minus interest payments. It shows the extent to which government borrowings are required to meet expenses other than interest payments, thereby highlighting current fiscal imbalances.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए : कथन 1 : जापान से भारी मशीनरी का आयात विदेशी मुद्रा की माँग का एक स्रोत है। कथन 2 : वायनाड (केरल) में भूस्खलन के लिए अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पुनर्निर्माण व विकास बैंक (IBRD) द्वारा वित्तीय सहायता, विदेशी मुद्रा की आपूर्ति का एक स्रोत है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: Import of heavy machinery from Japan is a source of demand for foreign exchange. Statement 2: Financial aid by International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) for landslide in Wayanad (Kerala) is a source of supply of foreign exchange.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (C). Imports require payment in foreign currency, thus creating demand for it. International financial aid represents an inflow of foreign currency into the country, thus acting as a source of supply.
questions.topic: Sources of Demand and Supply of Foreign Exchange

questions.text: एक द्वि-क्षेत्रीय अर्थव्यवस्था में, समग्र माँग _______ व _______ के योगफल द्वारा निर्धारित की जा सकती है।
questions.text_english: In a two-sector economy, the Aggregate Demand can be determined by adding _______ and _______.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थानों की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill in the blanks)
questions.solution: The correct option is (A). In a simple two-sector economy consisting only of households and firms, Aggregate Demand (AD) is the sum of planned consumption expenditure (C) and planned investment expenditure (I).

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए : कथन 1 : सरकार किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में प्रचलित अपस्फीतिकारी अंतराल को नियंत्रित करने के लिए, रेपो दर में कमी कर सकती है। कथन 2 : सरकार खुले बाज़ार में सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों (G-Sec) की बिक्री द्वारा, अपस्फीतिकारी अंतराल में कमी कर सकती है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: The government may reduce the repo rate, to control deflationary gap prevailing in the economy. Statement 2: The government may reduce the deflationary gap, by selling off government securities (G-Sec) in the open market.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (A). Reducing the repo rate encourages lending and increases money supply, which helps close a deflationary gap. Conversely, selling government securities in the open market reduces the money supply, which would worsen a deflationary gap, making Statement 2 incorrect.

questions.text: साधन लागत पर सकल मूल्य वृद्धि (GVA_FC) के मूल्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए, बाज़ार कीमत पर सकल मूल्य वृद्धि (GVA_MP) में/में से _______ को _______ जाना चाहिए।
questions.text_english: To arrive at the value of Gross Value Added at Factor Cost (GVA_FC), _______ must be _______ to/from Gross Value Added at Market Price (GVA_MP).
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थानों की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill in the blanks)
questions.solution: The correct option is (D). GVA at Factor Cost is derived by subtracting Net Indirect Taxes (Indirect Taxes minus Subsidies) from GVA at Market Price, as market price includes taxes which are not part of the factor income.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए : कथन 1 : सार्वजनिक वस्तुएँ, वे वस्तुएँ होती हैं, जिनके लिए राष्ट्र की समस्त इकाइयों द्वारा भुगतान किया जाता है। कथन 2 : निजी वस्तुएँ, वे वस्तुएँ होती हैं, जो किसी राष्ट्र की सरकार द्वारा उपदानित (subsidised) दरों पर उपलब्ध कराई जाती हैं।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: Public goods are those goods for which the payments are made by all the entities in the country. Statement 2: Private goods are those goods which are provided by the government of a country at subsidised rates.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (D). Public goods are non-excludable and non-rivalrous, and their provision is typically funded by taxes rather than direct individual payments by all entities. Private goods are items consumed by individuals and are typically sold in markets at market prices, not necessarily subsidized by the government.

questions.text: (क) किसी देश में राष्ट्रीय आय के आकलन की आय विधि से संबंधित किन्हीं दो सावधानियों की व्याख्या कीजिए। अथवा (ख) निम्नलिखित काल्पनिक आँकड़ों के आधार पर: वर्ष 2020-21 (नाममात्र GDP: 3,000, आधार वर्ष समायोजित: 5,000) वर्ष 2022-23 (नाममात्र GDP: 4,000, आधार वर्ष समायोजित: 6,000) 2020–21 को आधार वर्ष मानते हुए, वर्ष 2022-23 में वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन की गणना कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) Explain any two precautions pertaining to the Income Method of Estimation of National Income in a country. OR (b) On the basis of the following hypothetical data: Year 2020-21 (Nominal GDP: 3,000, Real GDP: 5,000) Year 2022-23 (Nominal GDP: 4,000, Real GDP: 6,000) Calculate the percentage change in Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in the year 2022-23 using 2020-21 as the base year.

key_points: Precaution 1: Exclude transfer payments like old-age pensions and scholarships as they do not contribute to current production.
Precaution 2: Exclude income from the sale of second-hand goods, as they were accounted for in the year they were produced.
Calculation for (b): Real GDP 2020-21 = 5,000. Real GDP 2022-23 = 6,000. Percentage change = ((6000-5000)/5000)*100 = 20%.

questions.solution: Under the Income Method, two precautions include excluding transfer payments like scholarships or unemployment allowances, as these do not involve the production of any goods or services. Additionally, one must exclude income from the sale of second-hand goods, as their original value was already counted in the year of their first production. For the numerical calculation, the Real GDP in 2020-21 was 5,000 crore and in 2022-23 it was 6,000 crore. The percentage change is calculated as ((6000 - 5000) / 5000) * 100, which equals 20 percent.

questions.text: "आय की असमानताओं को कम करने के लिए कराधान एक प्रभावी उपकरण है।" वैध कारणों द्वारा दिए गए कथन का औचित्य सिद्ध कीजिए।
questions.text_english: "Taxation is an effective tool to reduce income inequalities." Justify the given statement with valid reasons.

key_points: Progressive taxation rates mean higher income earners pay a larger percentage of their income as tax.
Tax revenues are used by the government for social welfare schemes targeting the poor.
Redistribution of wealth reduces the income gap between the rich and the poor.

questions.solution: Taxation acts as an effective redistributive tool through progressive taxation. Higher income earners are taxed at higher marginal rates, which reduces their disposable income. The revenue generated is subsequently used by the government to fund social welfare programs, subsidies, and public services that directly benefit lower-income groups. This mechanism reduces the overall income gap between the affluent and the underprivileged, promoting greater economic equity in the society.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए : एक शोध संस्था द्वारा निर्गमित एक रिपोर्ट में कहा गया है कि अर्थव्यवस्था में समग्र माँग, विशेषकर निजी उपभोग खंड में, तीव्र गिरावट आई है। वृहद आर्थिक चरों में यह कमी, आर्थिक गतिविधियों को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए रणनीतिक कार्यवाहियों की तत्काल आवश्यकता को परिलक्षित करती है। दिए गए गद्य तथा सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर, उन उपायों की व्याख्या कीजिए जिन्हें सरकार संकेतिक समस्या को ठीक करने के लिए उठा सकती है।
questions.text_english: Read the following text carefully : According to a report issued by a research organisation, there is a sharp decline in the overall demand in the economy, particularly in the private consumption segment. This dip in the macro economic variables, highlights the urgent need for strategic actions to stimulate economic activities. On the basis of the given text and common understanding, explain the measure which the government may take to solve the indicated problem.

key_points: Increase in government spending on infrastructure.
Reduction in personal income taxes to boost disposable income.
Reduction in interest rates to encourage borrowing and consumption.
Providing direct cash transfers to vulnerable sections.

questions.solution: To address a decline in aggregate demand, the government can adopt expansionary fiscal and monetary policies. Firstly, the government can increase its own expenditure on public works and infrastructure, which creates jobs and injects money into the economy. Secondly, reducing personal income taxes increases the disposable income of households, encouraging them to consume more. Additionally, the central bank can lower interest rates to make borrowing cheaper for consumers and firms, further stimulating private consumption and investment. These combined strategies help bridge the output gap and promote economic growth during a period of demand contraction.

questions.text: (क) भुगतान संतुलन खाते के अंतर्गत पूँजी खाते के किन्हीं दो घटकों की व्याख्या कीजिए। अथवा (ख) स्वायत्त लेनदेनों व समायोजन लेनदेनों में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) Elaborate any two components of the Capital Account under the Balance of Payments Account. OR (b) Distinguish between Autonomous transactions and Accommodating transactions.

key_points: Components of Capital Account: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) and External Commercial Borrowings (ECB).
Distinction: Autonomous transactions are for profit motive, independent of BoP status. Accommodating transactions are to correct BoP disequilibrium.

questions.solution: The Capital Account consists of various items reflecting changes in a country's foreign assets and liabilities. Two key components are Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), which involves long-term investment by foreign entities in domestic businesses, and External Commercial Borrowings (ECB), which refers to debt raised by domestic firms from international markets. Alternatively, autonomous transactions are those international economic transactions carried out for profit motive, independently of the balance of payments position. Conversely, accommodating transactions are undertaken by monetary authorities specifically to bridge the surplus or deficit in the balance of payments to restore equilibrium.

questions.text: एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए निम्नलिखित को मानते हुए, सम-स्तर आय व संतुलन आय के स्तरों का अनुमान लगाइए : (i) स्वायत्त उपभोग व्यय (C0) = ₹50 करोड़ (ii) सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति (MPS) = 0.2 (iii) स्वायत्त निवेश (I0) = ₹100 करोड़
questions.text_english: Assuming the following for a hypothetical economy, estimate the Break-even level of Income and Equilibrium level of Income: (i) Autonomous Consumption Expenditure (C0) = ₹50 crore (ii) Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS) = 0.2 (iii) Autonomous Investments (I0) = ₹100 crore

key_points: Break-even level (C=Y): Y = C0 / (1-MPC). Given MPS=0.2, MPC=0.8. Break-even Y = 50/0.2 = 250 crore.
Equilibrium level (AD=Y): Y = (C0 + I0) / (1-MPC). Y = (50+100) / 0.2 = 150 / 0.2 = 750 crore.

questions.solution: In this economy, given MPS = 0.2, the MPC is 1 - 0.2 = 0.8. The break-even level of income occurs where consumption equals income (C = Y), which is found by the formula Y = C0 / (1 - MPC). Thus, Y = 50 / 0.2 = 250 crore. The equilibrium level of income occurs where Aggregate Demand equals Aggregate Supply (Y = AD). Using the formula Y = (C0 + I0) / MPS, we get Y = (50 + 100) / 0.2 = 150 / 0.2 = 750 crore. Therefore, the break-even level is 250 crore and the equilibrium level is 750 crore.

questions.text: (क) (i) मान लीजिए कि, एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था में केवल तीन फर्मे X, Y व Z हैं। लेनदेन: (I) फर्म X ने Y को 20,000 व Z को 12,000 माल बेचा। (II) फर्म Y ने X को 11,000 व Z को 35,000 माल बेचा। (III) फर्म Z ने गृहस्थों को 57,000 माल बेचा। GDP_MP की गणना कीजिए। (ii) 20 नए अस्पतालों के निर्माण का GDP व कल्याण पर प्रभाव। अथवा (ख) (i) NDP_FC की गणना कीजिए। मदें: गृहस्थ उपभोग (800), सकल स्थायी निवेश (150), आवासीय निर्माण (120), सरकारी उपभोग (270), आयात-निर्यात (20), इन्वेंटरी निवेश (50), सकल सार्वजनिक निवेश (130), निवल अप्रत्यक्ष कर (20), विदेशों से निवल कारक आय (-25), स्थायी पूँजी उपभोग (40). (ii) आय के चक्रीय प्रवाह में 'निपटान' चरण की व्याख्या।
questions.text_english: (a) (i) Suppose there are only three firms X, Y and Z. Transactions: (I) Firm X sold goods worth 20,000 to Y and 12,000 to Z. (II) Firm Y sold goods worth 11,000 to X and 35,000 to Z. (III) Firm Z sold goods worth 57,000 to households. Calculate GDP_MP. (ii) Discuss the impact of 20 new hospitals on GDP and welfare. OR (b) (i) Estimate NDP_FC. Items: Household Consumption (800), Gross Fixed Capital Formation (150), Residential Construction (120), Govt Consumption (270), Excess of Imports over Exports (20), Inventory Investments (50), Gross Public Investments (130), Net Indirect Taxes (20), NFIA (-25), Depreciation (40). (ii) Justify that 'Disposition phase' involves flow of factor income.

key_points: For (a)(ii): GDP increases as construction is an economic activity. Welfare may increase due to better health services.
For (b)(i): NDP_FC = C + G + I + (X-M) - Dep - NIT = 800 + 270 + (150+120+130+50) - 20 - 40 - 20 = 1440. Adjust for NFIA if needed.
For (b)(ii): Disposition phase relates to spending, which ultimately distributes income to factor owners.

questions.solution: For part (a)(i), the value added by each firm is: X = (20,000 + 12,000) - 11,000 = 21,000. Firm Y = (11,000 + 35,000) - 20,000 = 26,000. Firm Z = 57,000 - (12,000 + 35,000) = 10,000. Total GDP = 21,000 + 26,000 + 10,000 = 57,000. Part (a)(ii): Constructing 20 new hospitals will increase GDP due to the injection of investment and construction activity. Welfare will likely rise as healthcare access improves. For part (b)(i), using the Expenditure Method: GDP_MP = 800 + 270 + (150 + 120 + 130 + 50) - 20 = 1,500. NDP_FC = 1,500 - 40 - 20 = 1,440 crore. Part (b)(ii): The disposition phase involves spending on final goods, which translates to revenue for firms, which is then distributed to households as factor income.

questions.text: (क) उपयुक्त संख्यात्मक उदाहरण द्वारा साख सृजन प्रक्रिया को विस्तार से समझाइए। (ख) निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए : "मुद्रा का यह कार्य एक सामान्य मानक के सामने मूल्यांकन की जाने वाली विभिन्न मदों को उपलब्ध कराता है। यह मूल्यों की तुलना करने व वित्तीय रिकॉर्ड रखने की अनुमति देता है।" (i) गद्य के आधार पर मुद्रा के कार्य की पहचान कीजिए। (ii) मुद्रा के किन्हीं दो अन्य कार्यों को सूचीबद्ध कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) Elaborate the process of credit creation using a suitable numerical example. (b) Read the following text: "This function of money provides different items to be evaluated against a common standard. It allows comparison of prices and keeping financial records." (i) Identify the indicated function of money. (ii) List any other two functions of money.

key_points: Credit creation: Initial deposit = 1000, LRR = 10%. Total Money = 1000 * (1/0.1) = 10000.
Function: Unit of account/Measure of value.
Other functions: Medium of exchange, Store of value.

questions.solution: Credit creation is the process where commercial banks expand the money supply through lending. Suppose an initial deposit is ₹1,000 and the Legal Reserve Ratio (LRR) is 10%. The bank keeps ₹100 as reserves and lends ₹900. This ₹900 is deposited elsewhere, becoming a new deposit. This cycle continues until the total money created is Original Deposit × (1/LRR), which is 1,000 × (1/0.1) = ₹10,000. Regarding part (b), the identified function is 'Measure of Value' or 'Unit of Account'. Two other functions of money are its role as a 'Medium of Exchange' and as a 'Store of Value'.

questions.text: पहचान कीजिए कि, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 1947 के पश्चात् भारत व पाकिस्तान की नीतियों में समानता को इंगित नहीं करता है।
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following does not indicate the similarities in the policies of India and Pakistan in the post 1947 period.
questions.instruction_line: (सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option)
questions.solution: The correct option is (A). India and Pakistan shared many similar economic policies after 1947, including the adoption of mixed economic systems, the implementation of import substitution strategies, and the green revolution to boost agricultural output. Dual pricing policy is not typically cited as a common structural similarity in their early developmental policy frameworks.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experience of India and its Neighbours

questions.text: पहचान कीजिए कि, भारत की ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन असत्य है।
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following statements is incorrect about the Rural Banking system in India.
questions.instruction_line: (सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option)

options.A: स्वतंत्रता उपरांत अवधि में, भारत में एक सुचारु रूप से संरचित ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली का निर्माण किया गया था।
options.B: भारत में ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली में बहु-एजेंसी संस्थानों का एक समूह सम्मिलित है।
options.C: क्षेत्रीय ग्रामीण बैंक, सहकारी व भूमि विकास बैंक भारत में ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली के कुछ महत्त्वपूर्ण घटक हैं।
options.D: भारत में ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली भारतीय स्टेट बैंक के मार्गदर्शन, निर्देशन व पर्यवेक्षण के अंतर्गत कार्य करती है।

options_english.A: In the post-independence period, a well-structured Rural Banking system was formulated in India.
options_english.B: Rural Banking system in India consists of a set of multi-agency institutions.
options_english.C: Regional Rural Banks, Cooperative and Land Development Banks are few important components of Rural Banking system in India.
options_english.D: Rural Banking system in India works under the guidance, instruction and supervision of the State Bank of India.

questions.solution: The correct option is (D). The rural banking system in India is primarily regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD), not exclusively under the guidance and supervision of the State Bank of India.

questions.text: स्वतंत्रता उपरांत अवधि में, भारत के नीति निर्माताओं ने प्रथम _______ पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं के लिए 'आत्मनिर्भरता' पर बल दिया था।
questions.text_english: In the post-independence era, the policy makers of India pushed for 'self-reliance' for the first _______ Five Year Plans.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: The correct option is (B). In the post-independence era, the strategy of self-reliance, meaning avoiding imports of food and other goods that could be produced domestically, was the primary focus of Indian economic planning for the first seven Five Year Plans.

questions.text: किसी विशेष फसल के स्थान पर, फसलों की विविध किस्मों का उत्पादन _______ के विविधीकरण के रूप में जाना जाता है।
questions.text_english: Production of diverse varieties of crops rather than one specialized crop is known as diversification of _______.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: The correct option is (A). Crop diversification refers to the shift from the dominance of one crop to the production of a variety of crops, which helps in risk management and improved soil health.

questions.text: पहचान कीजिए कि, पर्यावरण के कार्यों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन असत्य है।
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following statements is incorrect about the functions of environment.
questions.instruction_line: (सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option)

options.D: जीवन की गुणवत्ता का ह्रास करना

questions.solution: The correct option is (D). The primary functions of the environment are to provide resources, absorb waste, and sustain life. Deteriorating the quality of life is a consequence of environmental degradation, not a functional role of the environment itself.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए : कथन 1 : भारतीय खाद्य निगम, बाज़ार तंत्र को सुधारने के उपाय के रूप में गेहूँ व चावल का बफर स्टॉक बनाए रखता है। कथन 2 : न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP), सरकार द्वारा कृषकों के हितों की रक्षा के लिए निर्धारित किया जाता है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: The Food Corporation of India maintains buffer stocks of wheat and rice as a measure to improve market mechanism. Statement 2: Minimum Support Price (MSP) is imposed by the government to safeguard the interest of farmers.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (C). Both statements are correct. The Food Corporation of India manages buffer stocks to ensure food security and stabilize market prices. MSP is a price floor set by the government to provide guaranteed minimum returns to farmers.

questions.text: मान लीजिए कि, एक अर्थव्यवस्था बिना किसी उचित रोज़गार के अवसरों में वृद्धि के, वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में वृद्धि की स्थिति का सामना कर रही है। आर्थिक भाषा में, ऐसी स्थिति को _______ वृद्धि कहा जाता है।
questions.text_english: Suppose an economy is experiencing a situation of rise in Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP), without any corresponding rise in the employment opportunities. In economic parlance, such a situation is termed as _______ growth.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: The correct option is (D). A situation where an economy grows in terms of output but fails to generate employment opportunities is known as jobless growth.
questions.chapter: Employment: Growth, Informalisation and Related Issues

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन कीजिए। अभिकथन (A) : परमिट लाइसेंस राज के अत्यधिक विनियमन ने कुछ निजी फर्मों को प्रतिस्पर्धी बनने से रोका था। कारण (R) : निजी क्षेत्र ने उत्पाद की गुणवत्ता व अन्तर्राष्ट्रीय प्रतिस्पर्धात्मकता में वृद्धि करने के बजाय लाइसेंस प्राप्ति में महत्त्वपूर्ण समय बर्बाद किया था।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): Excessive regulation of permit license raj prevented certain private firms from becoming more efficient. Reason (R): Private sector wasted a significant time in obtaining licenses rather than enhancing product quality and international competitiveness.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है。

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (A). The permit license raj introduced excessive bureaucratic controls which hindered the efficiency and competitiveness of private firms. Firms had to spend extensive time navigating the licensing system instead of focusing on productivity, R&D, and quality improvement, which directly explains the assertion.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए : कथन 1 : भारतीय कृषि के व्यावसायीकरण के लिए ब्रिटिश नीतियाँ ज़िम्मेदार थीं। कथन 2 : भारतीयों के व्यापक हितों के लिए, ब्रिटिश शासकों ने भारत की आधारिक संरचना के विकास पर ध्यान केन्द्रित किया था।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully : Statement 1: The British policies were accountable for commercialisation of Indian agriculture. Statement 2: In the larger interest of Indians, the British rulers focused on the infrastructural growth of India.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (A). British policies did force the commercialization of agriculture to meet the needs of British industry. However, the development of infrastructure like railways and ports was primarily to facilitate the colonial exploitation of resources and the import of British goods, not in the interest of Indians.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन कीजिए। अभिकथन (A) : मानव पूँजी में निवेश में विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय लेने के लिए सूचना महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है। कारण (R) : लोग श्रम बाज़ार व अन्य क्षेत्रों जैसे शिक्षा तथा स्वास्थ्य के बारे में सूचना प्राप्त करने के लिए निवेश करते हैं।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from the options given below : Assertion (A): Information plays a crucial role in judicious decision-making about investing in human capital. Reason (R): Individuals invest to acquire information about the labour market and other areas such as education and healthcare.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है。

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (A). Having accurate information about the labour market, educational opportunities, and health services is essential for individuals to make informed decisions regarding investments in their own skills and education, which directly justifies why information is crucial for human capital formation.

questions.text: पाकिस्तान में गरीबी के उद्भव के लिए ज़िम्मेदार कारणों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Elaborate the reasons responsible for emergence of poverty in Pakistan.

key_points: Low and volatile agricultural productivity.
Political instability and poor governance.
High dependence on foreign loans and external debt.

questions.solution: Poverty in Pakistan has been driven by several structural and policy-related factors. Firstly, the heavy dependence on agriculture, which is prone to climatic shocks, has led to volatile income growth. Secondly, political instability and ineffective governance have hampered the implementation of long-term development programs. Finally, high reliance on foreign loans and a mounting external debt burden have constrained the government's ability to invest in essential social services like health and education, perpetuating the cycle of poverty.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experience of India and its Neighbours

questions.text: (क) "ब्रिटिश शासन के अंतर्गत, भारत को व्यवस्थित आर्थिक शोषण का सामना करना पड़ा, इसके साथ संसाधन व धन संपदा ब्रिटेन को हस्तांतरित किए गए थे।" वैध स्पष्टीकरण द्वारा पुष्टि कीजिए। अथवा (ख) 1991 के सुधारों में भारत सरकार द्वारा अपनाई गई नवरत्न नीति का मूल्यांकन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) "Under British rule, India underwent systematic economic exploitation, with its resources and wealth being transferred to Britain." Justify the given statement with valid explanation. OR (b) Appraise the Navratna policy adopted by the Government of India during the 1991 reforms.

key_points: Colonial exploitation: India was reduced to a supplier of raw materials and a market for British finished goods.
Drain of wealth: Taxes and resource revenue were used to finance colonial administration and wars, diverting funds from domestic development.
Navratan policy: Focused on granting autonomy to profitable Public Sector Units (PSUs) to enhance efficiency and global competitiveness.

questions.solution: Under British rule, India's economy was transformed into a supplier of raw materials and an importer of expensive finished goods, preventing industrial development. The 'drain of wealth' occurred as India's tax revenues and resource surpluses were utilized to finance British colonial administration, wars, and the needs of the British economy, effectively denying India the capital needed for its own development. Alternatively, the Navratna policy focused on granting greater operational and financial autonomy to selected highly profitable Public Sector Units (PSUs). This allowed these enterprises to become more efficient, professional, and globally competitive, playing a key role in the success of the post-1991 economic reforms.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence / Liberalisation

questions.text: (क) (i) मानव पूँजी व भौतिक पूँजी में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए। (ii) ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में 'LPG' व 'गोबर गैस' का धारणीय विकास प्राप्त करने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली रणनीति के रूप में वर्णन कीजिए। अथवा (ख) (i) ग्रामीण भारत में सूक्ष्म-साख (micro-credit) कार्यक्रमों का आलोचनात्मक मूल्यांकन कीजिए। (ii) धारणीय विकास के अर्थ का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) (i) Distinguish between human capital and physical capital. (ii) Describe 'LPG' and 'Gobar Gas' as strategies used to achieve sustainable development in rural areas. OR (b) (i) Critically appraise the micro-credit programmes in rural India. (ii) State the meaning of sustainable development.

key_points: Distinction: Human capital relates to skills, education, and health of the population. Physical capital relates to machines, infrastructure, and tools.
LPG/Gobar Gas: LPG reduces reliance on wood/dung burning, protecting forests. Gobar gas uses waste efficiently as fuel.
Micro-credit: Empowerment through financial inclusion, but issues exist regarding high interest rates and dependence on small-scale loans.
Sustainable development: Development that meets current needs without compromising future generations' ability to meet their needs.

questions.solution: Human capital refers to the knowledge, skills, and health of a population, whereas physical capital refers to tangible assets like machinery, buildings, and infrastructure. In rural areas, promoting LPG and Gobar Gas as clean cooking fuels is a key strategy for sustainable development; LPG reduces dependence on firewood, preventing deforestation, while Gobar gas effectively recycles animal waste into a source of energy. Regarding micro-credit, these programs have been instrumental in financial inclusion and poverty alleviation for women and small farmers. However, critics point to high interest rates, the small scale of loans, and lack of integration with broader developmental efforts as ongoing challenges. Sustainable development is defined as meeting the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
questions.chapter: Human Capital Formation / Rural Development / Sustainable Development

questions.text:
तीव्र गति से वृद्धिमान जनसंख्या के प्रति-उत्तर में, चीन ने 'एकल संतान नीति' प्रारंभ की थी। इस नीति के अंतर्गत युगलों (couples) को केवल एक ही संतान पैदा करने की अनुमति प्रदान की गई थी। इस नीति ने चीन को जनसंख्या वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने में सहायता की थी।

इस नीति के महत्त्वपूर्ण परिणाम भी उत्पन्न हुए, जैसे कि वृद्धों की अधिक जनसंख्या, पुत्रों को प्राथमिकता देने के कारण लिंग असंतुलन एवं एकल संतानों के लिए सामाजिक चुनौतियाँ आदि।

2015 में इस नीति में ढील दी गई, जिससे सभी युगलों को दो संतान पैदा करने की अनुमति मिल गई थी तथा 2021 में इसे और शिथिल करके तीन संतानों तक कर दिया गया था।

कुल मिलाकर, जबकि एकल संतान नीति ने जनसंख्या वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने के अपने प्राथमिक लक्ष्य को प्राप्त किया था, परन्तु इसने जनसांख्यिकीय व सामाजिक चुनौतियों का एक जटिल समूह भी उत्पन्न किया जिसका सामना चीन आज भी कर रहा है।
questions.text_english:
In response to the problem of rapidly rising population, China introduced the 'One Child Policy'. The policy restricted couples to having only one child. This policy helped China to limit the population growth.

This policy led to significant consequences, such as an increase ageing population, gender imbalances due to male child preference and social challenges for single children, etc.

This policy was relaxed in 2015, allowing all couples to have two children and further relaxed to three children in 2021.

Overall, while the One Child Policy achieved its primary goal of controlling population growth, it also created a complex set of demographic and social challenges that China continues to address today.

sub_questions.text: चीन में एकल संतान नीति के कार्यान्वयन के परिणामों को समझाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the consequences of implementation of the One Child Policy in China.

key_points: Increase in the ageing population.
Gender imbalance due to a cultural preference for male children.
Social challenges arising for the generation of single children.

sub_questions.solution: The implementation of the One Child Policy in China led to several significant demographic and social consequences. Primarily, it resulted in a rapidly ageing population due to declining birth rates. Furthermore, due to a cultural preference for male children, the policy contributed to severe gender imbalances. Finally, it created unique social challenges for single children, such as increased family pressure and support responsibilities, which continue to influence China's social structure today.

sub_questions.text: चीन में एकल संतान नीति के कार्यान्वयन के किसी एक कारण का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any one reason for the implementation of the One Child Policy in China.

key_points: The need to control the problem of rapidly rising population.

sub_questions.solution: The primary reason for the implementation of the One Child Policy in China was the government's need to control the problem of a rapidly rising population.

questions.text: मान्य तर्कों द्वारा, उल्लेख व विस्तृत व्याख्या कीजिए कि निम्नलिखित कथन सत्य हैं अथवा असत्य : (क) जैविक कृषि, महँगे कृषि आगतों को स्थानीय स्तर पर उत्पादित जैविक आगतों से प्रतिस्थापित करने का एक साधन प्रदान करती है। (ख) भारत में कार्यबल के अनौपचारीकरण ने देश के युवाओं के मध्य रोज़गार सृजन के मोर्चे पर विभिन्न चिंताओं में वृद्धि की है।
questions.text_english: State and elaborate whether the following statements are true/false, with valid arguments: (a) Organic farming offers a means to substitute costlier agricultural inputs with locally produced organic inputs. (b) Informalisation of workforce in India, has increased various concerns on the front of employment generation among the youth of the country.

key_points: Statement (a) is True: Organic farming uses natural inputs like manure, reducing dependence on synthetic, expensive fertilizers.
Statement (b) is True: Informal jobs often lack security, benefits, and job stability, creating anxiety for youth seeking career stability.

questions.solution: Statement (a) is true. Organic farming promotes the use of natural fertilizers such as compost and manure, which can be produced on-farm or locally, thereby replacing expensive, synthetic, and imported agricultural inputs. Statement (b) is also true. The informalization of the workforce means more workers are employed in jobs that lack formal contracts, job security, social benefits, and retirement provisions. This trend creates significant concern for youth who struggle to find stable, well-paying careers with growth prospects in the modern economy.

questions.text:
आवधिक श्रम बल सर्वेक्षण के आँकड़ों के अनुसार, विगत छः वर्षों में, भारतीय श्रम बाज़ार संकेतकों में सुधार हुआ है। 2022-23 में बेरोज़गारी दर घट कर 3.2% हो गई है। कार्यबल में युवाओं व महिलाओं की भागीदारी में वृद्धि से जनसांख्यिकीय व लैंगिक लाभांश का लाभ उठाने के अवसर प्राप्त हुए हैं। फैक्ट्री रोज़गार आँकड़े वित्तीय वर्ष 2022-23 में संगठित विनिर्माण क्षेत्र में उछाल को दर्शाते हैं इसके साथ ही रोज़गार में वृद्धि व कारखानों का विस्तार सम्मिलित है।

विगत पाँच वर्षों में EPFO के अंतर्गत शुद्ध वेतन प्राप्त करने वाले दोगुने से अधिक हो गए हैं, जो कि स्वस्थ विकास व औपचारिक रोज़गार का संकेत है।

गुणवत्तापूर्ण रोज़गार सृजन करने व उसे बनाए रखने के लिए कृषि-प्रसंस्करण व देखभाल अर्थव्यवस्था के दो आशाजनक विकल्प हैं।
questions.text_english:
As per the Periodic Labour Force Survey Data, Indian labour market indicators have improved in the last six years. The unemployment rate has fallen to 3.2% in 2022-23. Rising youth and female participation in the workforce present an opportunity to tap the demographic and gender dividend. The factory employment data exhibits the bounce back of the organised manufacturing sector in FY 2022-23 with rise in employment and the upscaling of factories.

The net payroll additions under EPFO have more than doubled in the past five years, signalling healthy growth in formal employment.

To generate and sustain quality employment, agro-processing and care economy are two promising candidates.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए गद्य व सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of the given text and common understanding, answer the following questions :

sub_questions.text: भारतीय कार्यबल में बढ़ती हुई युवा व महिला भागीदारी का कोई एक महत्त्व बताइए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any one significance of rising youth and female participation in the Indian workforce.

key_points: It helps in tapping the demographic and gender dividend, leading to higher economic growth.

sub_questions.solution: The rising youth and female participation in the workforce is significant because it provides an opportunity to effectively tap into the demographic and gender dividend, thereby accelerating overall economic growth.

sub_questions.text: भारत में गुणवत्तापूर्ण रोज़गार सृजन हेतु आशाजनक माने जाने वाले किन्हीं दो क्षेत्रों की पहचान कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify any two sectors which may be highlighted as promising for generating quality employment in India.

key_points: Agro-processing
Care economy

sub_questions.solution: As highlighted in the text, the two promising sectors for generating and sustaining quality employment in India are the agro-processing sector and the care economy.

sub_questions.text: उपयुक्त उदाहरण की सहायता से प्रच्छन्न बेरोज़गारी के अर्थ की विस्तृत व्याख्या कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Elaborate the meaning of disguised unemployment with the help of a suitable example.

key_points: Definition: Situation where more people are engaged in a job than required.
Example: A small family farm requiring two people, but five family members are working, making the marginal productivity of three members zero.

sub_questions.solution: Disguised unemployment is a situation where more people are engaged in a job than are actually required for the task. If these extra people are removed, the total output remains unchanged. A classic example is found in agriculture, where a small farm may require only two workers, but five family members are working on it. Because the farm's output does not decrease when the three additional workers are removed, their marginal productivity is zero, making them disguisedly unemployed.

questions.text_english:
(a) (i) "The Indian economy has greatly benefited from the process of globalisation." Justify the given statement with valid arguments. (ii) Distinguish between multilateral trade and bilateral trade.
OR
(b) (i) Discuss briefly the foreign exchange reforms undertaken by the Government of India in the post-1991 period. (ii) Distinguish between tariffs and quotas.

key_points: Globalisation benefits: Increased access to foreign capital (FDI), technology transfer, integration into global markets, and increased export potential.
Trade distinction: Multilateral involves trade between more than two countries. Bilateral involves trade between exactly two countries.
1991 FX reforms: Devaluation of Rupee, introduction of market-determined exchange rate, and convertibility on current account.
Trade barriers: Tariffs are taxes on imports. Quotas are quantitative restrictions on imports.

questions.solution: Globalisation has significantly benefited the Indian economy by attracting foreign direct investment (FDI), facilitating technological transfer, and integrating domestic firms into the global supply chain, which boosts export performance and competition. Regarding trade, multilateral trade involves agreements between more than two countries, while bilateral trade is between just two countries. In the post-1991 era, foreign exchange reforms included the devaluation of the Rupee to correct balance of payments issues, the transition toward a market-determined exchange rate system, and achieving current account convertibility. Finally, tariffs are taxes imposed on imported goods to increase their price, whereas quotas represent a direct quantitative restriction on the volume of imports allowed into a country.
